detail.longDescription: RESEARCH | Targeting the tumor immune microenvironment to overcome chemotherapy resistance in mesothelioma Researchers from the GIGA have identified a mechanism through which pleural mesothelioma cells modify their immune microenvironment to promote chemotherapy resistance. By blocking this communication between tumor cells and macrophages, they were able to slow tumor growth in experimental models. 👉️ https://www. giga.uliege.be/cms/c_13755785/ en/mesothelioma-a-new-approach-to-overcoming-chemotherapy-resistance # cancer # health # research
